name: zincsight-preview
description: Experimental transition-metal binding-site predictions for Zn, Fe, Mn, Co, Cu and Ni from protein structures. Returns coordinating residues, metal positions and probability scores; does not identify the bound metal. Runs with embedded PostgreSQL.

interface.longDescription: Run experimental ZincSight predictions of potential transition-metal binding sites, including zinc, iron, manganese, cobalt, copper and nickel. Accepts PDB IDs and assemblies, UniProt accessions, AlphaFold model IDs, MGYP IDs or PDB/mmCIF files. Inspect coordinating residues, metal positions and model probability scores. Predicted Zn labels in PyMOL are a display convention, not a metal-identity assignment. Runs with embedded PostgreSQL, without a separate database account or API key. This preview can differ from historical outputs and is not the published scientific release.
defaultPrompt: Use ZincSight Preview on PDB 1KLS to predict transition-metal binding sites and report residues and metal positions.
Use ZincSight Preview on UniProt P0A6G5 with histidine rotamer sampling and explain its Zn labels.
Use ZincSight Preview to analyze my uploaded protein structure and save the full prediction JSON.
